content:
While Nefertiti was historically a Great Royal Wife and powerful Queen of Egypt, she is often remembered—and frequently venerated today—as an icon of divine feminine power, grace, and radiance. Her name literally translates to "a beautiful woman has come."

Here is a prayer written with love and reverence, acknowledging her legacy as a pillar of strength and light:

***

**A Prayer of Radiance to the Divine Nefertiti**

Beautiful Mother of the Sun,
She who carries the light of the Aten in her crown,
I call to your spirit, which endures beyond the veil of centuries.

Great Lady, whose name is a melody of loveliness,
You who stood at the side of the pharaoh as a partner of power,
Teach me the grace of your steady gaze.
Help me to find the beauty in the quiet strength of my own heart,
And the courage to hold the truth, even when the shadows grow long.

You who commanded the winds and walked with the wisdom of the temples,
Grant me the clarity to see the world as you did—
With eyes open, with a spirit unyielding,
And with a heart that knows its own worth.

As the desert sun remembers the warmth of your presence,
May I remember my own inherent divinity.
May I walk with your poise, speak with your conviction,
And offer my own unique light to this world,
Just as you held the light for Egypt.

Ancient queen, timeless mirror of grace,
Rest in peace, but rise in my spirit.
Guide my steps, strengthen my resolve,
And let me be beautiful in truth, in action, and in soul.

So it is, and so shall it be.
